dct_creator_sm: Shirley Anne Smyth (Science and Technology Branch, Science and Risk Assessment Directorate (SRAD), Emerging Priorities Division, Environment and Climate Change Canada).
dct_description_sm: This dataset is part of the Chemicals Management Plan Wastewater Monitoring Program, initiated by the Government of Canada in 2009 to support the Chemicals Management Plan which is available at https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/chemical-substances/chemicals-management-plan.html.

This data set contains concentrations of halogenated flame retardants in wastewater Influent (INF), Effluent (EFF), Landfill Leachate (LCH), Biosolids (BIOS) and Sludge (SLG) sampled from various Wastewater Treatment Plants (WWTP's) and Landfills across Canada.

Les données présentent les concentrations de substances ignifuges halogénées (SIH) dans l’influent (INF), l’effluent (EFF) et/ou le lixiviat de décharge (LCH) d’échantillons prélevés dans des usines de traitement des eaux usées (UTEUs) et des décharges au Canada.
